headline: 3D movies are finally worth watching
summary: 3D movies are experiencing a surprising resurgence after years of being a tech flop. New display technologies are making the 3D viewing experience genuinely enjoyable. Fans are now eagerly collecting 3D Blu-rays, reigniting interest in the format.

headline: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
summary: Meta has open-sourced code for its Muse AI agent, allowing users to build custom gadgets. Projects include loading Muse onto E Ink displays for reminders or HDMI sticks for big screens. This move aims to foster innovation and personal customization with Meta's AI.

headline: Netflix is pivoting away from prestige
summary: Netflix is reportedly shifting its strategy away from high-budget, critically acclaimed "prestige" content. The streamer has ended multiyear production deals with prominent directors like David Fincher. This move indicates a change in focus, possibly towards more mainstream or cost-effective productions.

headline: Apple to limit Mac disk access due to AI agent risks
summary: Apple is implementing new limits on "full disk access" for macOS applications. The change is a direct response to security risks posed by increasingly powerful AI agents. New controls will ensure users can only grant extraordinary access intentionally and securely.

headline: Prime Day Deals: Save Big on Tolkien's Lord of the Rings and Hobbit Books
summary: Amazon is offering significant discounts on J.R.R. Tolkien's fantasy books. Titles like "The Lord of the Rings," "The Hobbit," and "The Silmarillion" are included. This sale comes ahead of Prime Day, making it a good time for fans to expand their collection.

headline: Love and Deepspace Devs Warn Players After Deadly Fictional Drink Recipes Go Viral
summary: "Love and Deepspace" developers issued a warning about fictional in-game drink recipes. These recipes, designed for the RPG-dating sim, could be dangerous if attempted in real life. The warning aims to prevent players from experimenting with potentially harmful concoctions.

headline: Capcom to Transform RE Engine into AI-Generation Game Engine
summary: Capcom announced plans to evolve its proprietary RE Engine into an AI-generation game engine. The goal is to collaborate with AI in game development, enhancing creation processes. This initiative reflects Capcom's vision for a future where AI actively assists in game design and production.

headline: Former NFL Coach Mike Tomlin: Hardcore Minecraft Player Reveals 12-Year City Build
summary: Former NFL coach Mike Tomlin is a dedicated Minecraft player. He unveiled an expansive in-game city he meticulously built over 12 years. Tomlin has also started a YouTube channel showcasing his Minecraft creations.

headline: Flydubai Co-Pilot Attacked Captain with Axe, UAE Official Reports
summary: A Flydubai co-pilot reportedly attacked the captain with an axe. The incident occurred on an Israel-bound flight. The accused, Hamam al-Hammami, was attempting to take over the jet.

headline: UK-Iranian Dual National Arrested Over RAF Fairford Released on Bail
summary: A 25-year-old UK-Iranian dual national was arrested in Westminster. The arrest was in connection with an incident at RAF Fairford. The individual has since been released on bail.

headline: Kemi Badenoch Aims to Re-energize Conservative Party with Core Principles
summary: Kemi Badenoch is expected to outline a return to core conservative principles. This strategy aims to bolster the party's presence on the national stage. Her address will take place at the Conservative party's annual conference.

headline: Russia Hits Second Major Bridge in Kyiv, Ukraine
summary: Russia has targeted and hit the Pivnichnyi (Northern) Bridge in Kyiv. This marks the second major bridge strike in the Ukrainian capital recently. The attack follows repeated assaults on another key bridge in the city.
